budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town has not spent any opioid settlement funds, has about $295,000 on hand, and is estimated to receive $722,000 in total through 2039.
budget_items.quote: the town has not spent any of its funds, has approximately $295,000 on hand, and is estimated to receive $722,000 in total through 2039

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY26 free cash is not available for appropriation until certified by the state, so action on free-cash articles may not be possible on September 3.
budget_items.quote: town manager warren-dyment cautioned that fy26 free cash is not available for appropriation until certified by the state

budget_items.topic: TC Passios heating and operating budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: There is no operating budget to heat TC Passios this winter, and services at the building will pause regardless of any decision.
budget_items.quote: she stated that there is no operating budget to heat the building this winter

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board was asked to consider how much to spend on outside estimators for cost estimates; a project estimator line was previously funded from free cash.
budget_items.quote: she asked the board to consider how much to spend on outside estimators for cost estimates

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A roof project funded in May 2027 could go out to bid no earlier than July 2027, with construction likely in fall 2027 or spring 2028.
budget_items.quote: she noted that a roof project funded in may 2027 could go out to bid no earlier than july 2027

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Both bids were rejected; the low bid lacked required documents and the second bid exceeded the budget. The Town will do part of the work internally and hire a vendor for the rest.
budget_items.quote: both bids for the 100 laurel lane sewer connection were rejected.
